summary: Iter19 backend+frontend review completed for admin daily payment entry rollout. Backend critical scenarios passed via isolated JWT + Mongo-seeded records, including cash/UPI immediate activation and screenshot ownership checks. Frontend source review found a blocking Admin UI regression for subscriber creation.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin users can open Add Subscriber modal but cannot input phone because phone field renders only for super_admin (`!editing && isSuper`). This blocks admin subscriber creation from UI despite backend allowing it.

integration_issues.flow: Authenticated admin web-flow validation for Add Daily Payment + Payments fallback rendering
integration_issues.issue: Runtime UI integration could not be executed in this run because no safe admin web session/token was provided and OTP/login was intentionally not invoked.

action_items: Fix admin subscriber-create form to render phone input for admin role (not only super_admin) so UI matches backend authorization.
After fix, run authenticated mobile-web Playwright for full Add Daily Payment and Admin Payments cash-fallback rendering verification.
Keep outbound WhatsBoost calls MOCKED in automated tests; current non-rollback behavior passed with MOCKED provider path.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: /api/admin/payment-entries enforces actor-owned screenshot for UPI and allows cash without screenshot as expected.
Frontend regression: `sub-phone` field in /app/frontend/app/(admin)/subscribers.tsx is gated by `isSuper`, conflicting with requirement that admin can create subscriber.
Config consistency note: frontend/src/api.ts derives base from expoConfig.extra.backendUrl/EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while platform guidance references EXPO_BACKEND_URL.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (source-level checks passed; authenticated runtime flow not executed)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST_ITER19 users/plan/files/payments via test fixture; automatic cleanup executed in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_credentials.md intentionally provides no privileged OTP creds; use short-lived local JWTs or provision a safe admin session for runtime UI. WhatsBoost non-rollback assertion was validated with MOCKED notification functions; no real external WhatsApp message send occurred in that test path.
rca_of_issue: Admin create-subscriber UI bug RCA: FAB visibility uses canManage (admin/super_admin), but phone input visibility uses `isSuper` only. Repro: login as admin -> Subscribers -> tap add-subscriber-fab -> modal lacks sub-phone field -> submit cannot satisfy backend required phone. Mitigation: gate phone input on `canManage` for create mode, then retest admin create flow and daily payment detail path.
